verdict.rationale: LobeHub advertises scheduling tasks for Agents to handle ('Schedule tasks and let Agents handle the rest') and has a dedicated Scheduled Task docs page. The Home dashboard surfaces what is still running and what Agents did while you were away, which supports autonomous background execution. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of trigger and schedule options and run limits (the Scheduled Task page appears only as a link title), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that background automations work reliably.
